description: Hand-authored Phase 5 Study Engine dev fixture, one example per study mode. Queries/topics are written against the subject matter of the project's existing Phase 1 ingestion fixtures (backend/tests/fixtures/) so a real end-to-end run (real ingestion + real retrieval + a real or mocked LLM) has plausible evidence to work with. Not derived from an actual ingestion run (unlike app.multimodal.evaluation.dataset.json) and carries no exact chunk ids for that reason -- see app.study.evaluation.dataset module docstring.

examples.note: Exercises count validation and per-question citation grounding.
Exercises front/back concision and duplicate detection.
